case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests praised the hotel's location, spacious comfortable rooms, facilities (pool, pool bar, restaurant, gym, spa, shop), attentive staff (one guest named Tatiana), breakfast variety, room upgrades and free parking. Reported issues included intermittent Wi‑Fi disconnections in some areas, recurring damaged beach/pool towels, limited vegetarian options at the dinner buffet, a cold outdoor pool for one guest, and no indoor pool.
